meta.scope: Classify the verified clinician-rated FLACC target using a controlled observer-rated pain construct

searches.query: 10.1109/TAFFC.2025.3567307 Section V-A FLACC rater and target construct

evidence.target_construct.reason: The VOR defines the target as average FLACC score assigned by 1-4 medical doctors per sample. This is an observer-rated clinical pain assessment, not self-report or facial expression; a dedicated controlled category now represents it.

locators.locator: Section V-A, p. 2833: average FLACC ratings by 1-4 medical doctors per sample; FLACC is an observer-rated behavioral pain scale.

decisions.notes: Full IEEE Version of Record checked; PDF SHA-256 7ee9edfd4974a9577bcc5769679f44df1dfa45932ae43f56b1997d8c89a92922. MPP contains 701 valid video samples with audio, not 701 identified participants. Target is average FLACC rated by 1-4 medical doctors/sample. Five-fold CV is reported; fold unit and participant-disjoint assignment are not. No external validation or uncertainty calibration reported. Data are available from corresponding author on request.
decisions.rationale: The already reviewed VOR explicitly identifies clinician-rated average FLACC labels. The former vocabulary-gap sentinel is no longer appropriate after adding the precise observer-rated clinical pain class. This correction changes only evidence.target_construct and its field resolution.
